text:
alex: Heads-up — cutover for release/2026.03 is at 22:00 UTC tonight. PR #8427 needs final approvals, currently only one approver has signed off. We need two distinct reviewers before cutoff.
meera: On it, which PR link? quick skim or full run of integration tests?
josh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8427 The change is a small fallback tweak for kv-cache warmup. Unit + smoke passed locally.
alex: thanks @josh. Needs a second reviewer to satisfy the release gate. cc @meera @elena if you have cycles.
meera: I can take a look now, give me ~20m. Will focus on the canary config and the test harness output.
release-bot: Reminder: release cutoffs enforce 2 reviewer approvals OR a release lead override within the last 30 mins before cutoff.
sam: if meera is on it, i can do the second check after her. willing to rubber-stamp if no functional risk. :thumbsup:
elena: I'm happy to be backup; currently on a support call but should be free in ~45m. If it blocks, ping me again and i'll jump in.
josh: quick note — changed default TTL for prefix cache in this PR, may affect latency spikes on cold-start. added a short blurb in the PR description.
meera: saw the TTL change. running through the load test log now.
meera: looks fine under our typical seq len distribution, but added one comment about a log-level nit. not a blocker.
alex: perfect. @meera can you approve after your comment if you're comfortable? then @sam can give the second approval so we meet 2-reviewer rule.
meera: approving now. :white_check_mark:
sam: approved. leaving one tiny suggestion but :+1: otherwise.
alex: great — we've hit the two-approver gate. I'll queue the merge before 21:45 UTC to leave time for smoke on staging.
elena: if anything pops on staging i can be on-call for the next hour post-deploy.
release-bot: Deploy window scheduled: staging 21:50 UTC, canary 22:05 UTC, full cut 22:30 UTC. Auto-rollback on error rate >1.5% over 5m.
alex: thanks everyone. filing a short post-deploy note in #eng-oncall when cutover completes. :rocket:
meera: nice, glad we caught the TTL tweak in time.
josh: appreciate the quick eyes team.
alex: thread closed once deployed, will reopen if any fails.
